notes: New: Dark mode. Use the new light/dark switch in Settings to change how the whole program looks.
New: Lavender theme in purples and lilac, plus Oceanic, Slate and Warm Neutral themes to choose from.
New: The calendar is now a month view with weeks across, showing each stay as a bar over its days.
New: Drag across days in the calendar to start a booking or block with those dates.
New: Filter the calendar by property, or show all properties together.
Improved: Panels, menus and side sheets now follow your chosen theme and dark mode.
